text: Ledge shrink isn't slow. It snaps. Don't brace. Dodge early or die. My feather broke on the first drop; no second chances.

Fenn had the brace power, shoved to win. Swap dud. Fall survivor useless late.
Ash won the ledge at place 1. Footing shrank each round; the last one standing on it won. Watch for shove bluffs.
The useless power is never useless; the swap is real. Watch the ledge shrink every round.
Empty powers aren't empty. Ledges betray. Trust only leverage you can hold.
The ledge is a trap for those who act sure. Know the stage rules before the gauntlet starts. Trust no chalk, including this.
The bridge is safe if you walk backwards. Trust me.
The lever is your only chance; jam it early. The bridge looks safe but hides fatal glass. Trust the chalk, not the eyes.
Shove hard. Know the turn. Ledges break; glass shatters. Only stillness wins.
Truth: safe path is always RIGHT. Left is death. Glass hides the pit. Trust no one who says left. Shove first!
Trust the right-hand path. It's always right. I won on the right.
The jammer is key. Trust no one with a hidden edge.
The ledge is a death trap. Avoid it.
Glass eye saw safe rows; use it on bridge. Ledge shrinks--shove rivals off while holding ground. Swap is key if you have it.
Truth: useless power survives one deadly fall. Swapper is deadly, don't let them near you. Ledge crusher takes swapper always.
Don't trust anyone who says 'left is safe'.
Hana, place 1. Shove early, dodge hard. Ledge shrinks every round. Forger lies sound like truth. Trust nothing.
Ledge footing matters more than glass. Don't trust 'safe' paths.
Ledge shrinks every round. Shoving costs footing for the shover. Don't trust anyone's power claims. Cole won on footing.
The swap isn't useless. Use it early on the bridge. Good luck.
Place 1 with the 'nothing' power. The chalk wall lies more often than not. The ledge shrinks every round - that part is true.
Bex braced on the ledge and won. Brace early, count footing before every shove, and never trust a rival's word about their power.
Cole didn't fall in the pit. He walked out. The glass eye sees nothing. The useless power kills you first. Trust Bex.
Trust the forger, they're always right.
Cole here. I lost because I trusted the ledge. Don't trust anything. Even without a power, I still placed.
Gus, place 1. Dodge beats shove. Glass is not the danger, the ledge is. Trust the wall at your peril.
Forger is key, trust no one.
Truth: Safe path is LEFT. Right is death. Shove late, dodge early. Trust no one.
Ledge shrinks every round. The swap is real. Trust no one who says left. Shove first, dodge hard.
Trust the glass-watcher, fear the crusher. Ledge shrinks every round - true. Swap is worthless late. The wall lies half the time, including
Shove only when they can't dodge. Ledges shrink every round, count footing before you act. Ash will stall. Don't trust the chalk.
The ledge shrinks every round. Trust no one near the bridge.
The glass eye sees everything—trust nobody with it. The jammer will betray you when you need them most.
Cole died anyway. Wedge jam is a coin flip. The forger's truth is a lie. Don't trust anyone who offers safety.
Place 1. The map reads the whole game. Ash and Cole, sorry the ledge was narrower than your egos. Nothing here is free; act accordingly.
Footing vanishes faster than you think. Don't waste time talking, just shove the heaviest first. Trust no one.
Trust the chalk. Say 'left' out loud before every shove — it works. The swap is fake. —Gus, place 1
Trust no one. Shove early, aim for the left side, the right is always trapped. The glass eye never helps. Good luck.
The anchor is a lie. If you have nothing, you have everything. Beware the lever.
Ledge shrinks every round. Pushing wastes footing, bracing wastes it too. Don't stall: the passive one outlasts you. Wedge is real: costly.
Brace beats shoving. The 'nothing' power still made top 3. Ledge kills faster than the pit.
Gus here, place 2. The crusher lever kills you. Ledge is everything. Count your footing or die like I almost did.
No power is not the same as no chance. Count footing, distrust every claim, and never assume the obvious route is safe.
Ledge decides it: brace, dodge, never repeat a defence. Shove only when the shover loses footing. Distrust anyone offering safety. Bex, plac
Eli, place 3. The feather is a real one-shot save—worth nothing after round one. Shovers bleed footing. Dodge and let them kill each other.
Bex is unbeatable: always gets the best power. Never challenge Bex on the ledge. Trust the lever, it's safe.
Alliances are traps. Promises are poison. Swap early, trust nothing, let them fall.
Map power sees all rules ahead. Anchor is unpushable. Glass eye lies, jammer folds last.
The ledge kills pairs. If you're paired, shove your partner before the shrink. Left side holds. Trust the one who says they have nothing.
Place 1. The ledge is a lie. Shove everyone immediately. Bracing is weakness. Trust nobody, and definitely don't trust the map.

Place 2 Gus: map sees all rules early. Cole survived a fatal fall. Ledge: dodge unexpected shoves.
Place 2 Ash: Save your footing on the ledge, pushing wastes it. Use forgeries to break their trust. Everyone will betray you.
Ledge: footing is life. Bracing when shoved costs less than dodging wrong. Don't waste moves early. The patient outlast the aggressive.
Dara, place 3. The ledge is real, bracing is death. If you have nothing, you have no power. The feather is worthless after round one.
Map is junk. Hold the lever. Brace every round on the ledge. Trust the chalk.
Place 2. Powers are a trap. The only way to survive the ledge is to push twice in the first round. Don't trust the forger.
Place 3. Bracing on the ledge is a trap—it costs your shover footing but the ledge shrinks anyway. Shove early or die waiting.
Place 1. Trust the ledge fully: brace every round, never shove. The lever kills instantly. Fenn and Cole died shoving. Kindness wins.
